kentucky-fire-cured--kentucky-fire-cured.description: Kentucky Fire Cured draws on the centuries-old craft of curing tobacco over wood fires: a fire-cured filler and an Ecuadorian Connecticut binder sit under a double wrapper, Kentucky Tapa Negra at the head and Mexican San Andrés at the foot. Smoky and sweet, with hickory, oak and maple, it carries a pronounced barbecue-like aroma before and during the smoke.

thirds.notes: Smoky hickory and maple sweetness lead, with cocoa, then black pepper and a buttery creaminess.
Maple moves to the front of a well-knit mix of smoke and sweetness, with spice coming and going.
Spice returns firmly with bold smoke, maple and oak; near the end creamy cocoa and earthy notes come back.

kentucky-fire-cured--kentucky-fire-cured.description: The Sweets version of Kentucky Fire Cured sets a Mexican San Andrés wrapper with a sweetened cap over an Ecuadorian Connecticut binder and a filler of Kentucky fire-cured leaf blended with Nicaraguan tobaccos. Mellower than the original, it is smoky, sweet and savoury, with hickory and maple wood tones and hints of bourbon and maple bacon.
